Name: Bigger Backpack 60 slots
Author: FrogSkyWater
Description:
[b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]

This is a fork of [url=https://github.com/bcmpinc/StardewHack]https://github.com/bcmpinc/StardewHack[/url] mod BiggerBackpack. All credits goes to @bcmpinc.

Buy a bigger backpack at Pierre's for only 50,000g! This backpack has 48 slots.

BUY AN EVEN BIGGER BACKPACK AT PIERRE'S FOR ONLY 100,000g! This backpack has 60 slots.

[b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b]
- Uninstall every backpack related mod (original Bigger Backpack, The Return Of Custom Backpack Framework, More Backpack Upgrades, etc.
- Download the mod, unzip it in the Mods folder 

[b][size=4]Config[/size][/b]
[i]Note: run Stardew Valley once with this mod enabled to generate the [code]config.json
[/code] file.[/i]
[list]
[*][code]BackpackCost[/code]: How much you have to pay to buy this backpack in the shop. Default 48 slots = 50000 and 60 slots costs 100000).
[/list][b]
[size=4]Console Commands
[/size][/b][list]
[*][code]player_setbackpacksize slots[/code]: Changes the size of your inventory. Valid values for slots are 12, 24, 36, 48 and 60. Items in
the removed slots will be spilled onto the ground.[b][u][color=#ff0000]
[size=4]/!\ NOTE : console commands seems not working yet /!\[/size][/color][/u][/b][/list][b]
[size=4]Dependencies[/size][/b]
This mod requires the following mods to be installed:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/tobedefined]SMAPI[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3213]StardewHack[/url]
[/list][b]
[size=4]Known bugs
[/size][/b][list]
[*]For now the 48 slots backpack and 60 slots backpack have the same sprite, and buying these 2 will show the red backpack instead of the custom one.
[*]It might return that you don't have enough money but will buy it anyway if you have enough money
[*]You will have to buy the 48 slots backpack again if you've used Bigger backpack before
[*]In every shops, using mouse to place an item in the 5th rows will close the interface (item is safe) - controller should be working fine
[/list]Please report bugs on [url=https://github.com/FrogSkyWater/Bigger-Backpack-60-slots/issues]Github[/url] or here on Nexus.
 


[list]
[*]This mod does not support android / mobile.
[/list][b]
[size=4]Uninstalling[/size][/b]
Remove folder from the /Mods folder and pray nothing break
[b]
